name: ui-design-knowledge-map
description: Maps UI components and topics to the reference files (paths relative to the skill root) for targeted reading.

retrieval_protocol.rule: Use knowledge_tree.json to find the reference file for a specific component, then read only that file.
retrieval_protocol.execution_pattern: 1. Identify the component or domain -> 2. Look it up here -> 3. Read the mapped reference -> 4. Apply its rules; verify with the gates in SKILL.md.

accessibility_rules: Must have accessible text name via content, aria-label, or aria-labelledby (button-name)
Minimum 4.5:1 text contrast ratio; minimum 3.0:1 boundary/graphic contrast
Target size: 24x24px minimum (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8); 44x44px for primary touch actions (see modules/ui-ux/references/review-checklist.md §1)
Visible focus ring with minimum 2px offset (never outline: none without replacement)
Never use positive tabindex
Associated <label for="id"> explicitly bound to control
Error messaging linked via aria-describedby and marked aria-invalid="true"
Placeholder is not a substitute for visible label
Contrast >= 4.5:1 for input text, >= 3.0:1 for border boundaries
Use <dialog> or role="dialog" with aria-modal="true"
Provide title via aria-labelledby targeting dialog heading
Trap keyboard focus within modal while open
Dismiss on Escape key and restore focus to trigger element upon closing
Contrast >= 3.0:1 for structural boundary/border against canvas
If card is clickable link, avoid nested interactive controls
Use semantic grouping (<article> or <section> with header) where applicable
Wrap in semantic <nav> landmark with unique aria-label
Active link marked with aria-current="page"
Mobile hamburger toggle has accessible name and aria-expanded state
Keyboard navigable with logical tab order
Implement role="combobox" or native <select>
Manage aria-expanded, aria-controls, and aria-haspopup
Arrow key navigation and Escape key dismissal
Clear accessible label
Semantic <table> with <caption> or aria-label
Column/row headers use <th scope="col"> or <th scope="row">
Sortable columns indicate sort state via aria-sort
Ensure table wrapper permits keyboard scrolling if overflow is scrollable
Use role="alert" (assertive) for critical errors; role="status" (polite) for general updates
Dismiss button must possess accessible aria-label
Do not rely solely on color to convey message severity (include icons/text)
Provide sufficient display time or avoid auto-dismiss for action-required alerts
Tabs: role="tablist", role="tab" (aria-selected, aria-controls), role="tabpanel"
Arrow key navigation between tabs (Home/End support)
Accordion: <button> triggers with aria-expanded and aria-controls linking panel
Tooltip must trigger on both hover and focus
Trigger has aria-describedby targeting tooltip id
Role="tooltip" for non-interactive text
Dismissible on Escape without moving pointer
Render on a dark viewport surface token (near-black) with HUD text at >= 4.5:1
Must use deterministic SVG radiograph simulation with anatomical bone/tooth landmarks (NEVER human portraits or stock photos)
Include DICOM HUD with study metadata, window/level sliders, and calibration scale (mm)
Accessible labels for all viewer tools (pan, zoom, contrast, invert)
High contrast waveform line against dark grid background (>= 3:1)
Tabular value readout with explicit clinical units (bpm, mmHg)
Multi-modal visual alerts (color + icon/sound label, conforming to WCAG non-color dependency)

visual_direction_and_tokens.summary: Creative posture (utilitarian, expressive, avant-garde), dual-direction exploration, and accessibility guardrails for expressive surfaces (scrims, decorator isolation, reduced motion).

component_contracts_and_states.summary: Prop contracts, state coverage (default, hover, focus, disabled, loading, error, empty), data extremes, truncation, and layout stability.

accessibility_and_rtl.summary: WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA & AAA standards, contrast ratios, keyboard navigation, focus indicators, touch targets, ARIA roles, RTL mirroring, Arabic/Persian script.

domain_semantics_and_entities.summary: Ontological domain grounding, entity classification (diagnostic assets, personnel, metrics, hardware, financial ledgers), and deterministic SVG mock asset standards to prevent semantic hallucinations.

quality_and_verification_rubric.summary: Result statuses, finding format, target-size policy, review checklist and verdicts.

decision_policies.summary: Decision record format, retrieval order, untrusted data, evidence expiry and attempt budget.

ux_patterns.summary: Flows, forms, validation, states, feedback timing, content and data-dense screens.

design_tokens.summary: Token layers, DTCG format accepted by the validator, contrast pairs with 'over', scales and drift prevention.
